name: AI LLM
description: Send prompts to an LLM (Language Model) and receive generated responses. Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs.
doc:
Connect to AI language models. Two modes:

**Internal** — Pure-Rust GGUF inference via plugin-llm (no network). Pick from the live model manifest; missing files show an inline Download button. Models stay resident across nodes until evicted (see Free VRAM toggle).

**External** — Any OpenAI-compatible HTTP server. Pick a preset to auto-fill endpoint + model + auth:
  • LM Studio (localhost:1234)
  • Ollama (localhost:11434)
  • OpenAI
  • Anthropic
  • Custom — raw override: edit endpoint / model / API key / request format by hand. Use this for OpenRouter, Groq, HuggingFace TGI, vLLM, etc.

Features:
• Vision support — attach images for multimodal models (External today; Internal once plugin-llm engine `forward_embeds` lands)
• Streaming responses
• Custom system prompts
• Configurable token limits
• API keys via Project Constants (avoid pasting into each node)

Legacy note: workflows saved with the older Google / OpenRouter / Groq / HuggingFace dropdown options render as External / Custom with their endpoint + model preserved.

inputs.name: Prompt
inputs.description: The user prompt to send to the LLM

inputs.name: Video
inputs.description: Optional video for models that support video understanding (MiniCPM-V 4.6 — up to 128 frames via stack_frames mode; future Qwen3-VL Video). The runtime extracts N evenly-spaced frames (controlled by 'Video Frames' below) and feeds them as image inputs through the existing vision-chat path. Ignored by text-only models.

outputs.name: Response
outputs.description: The generated response from the LLM

properties.name: Service Preset
properties.description: Pick a registered service to auto-fill endpoint + model + headers (manage in Settings → Services). Inline fields below still override the preset's values. Leave blank to use the Provider dropdown defaults.

properties.name: Provider
properties.description: Local AI engine (OpenAI-compatible HTTP). Cloud providers (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / OpenRouter / Groq) were removed for the local-first build — re-add entries here (and uncomment them in AILLMNode.tsx EXTERNAL_PRESETS) if needed.

properties.name: API Key Constant
properties.description: Name of the constant containing the API key (overrides manual key)

properties.name: Custom Headers
properties.description: Custom headers (JSON)

properties.name: Image Input Count
properties.description: Number of image inputs for vision

properties.name: Video Frames
properties.description: Number of frames to extract from the connected Video input. Frames are sampled evenly across the clip and fed to the vision tower one-per-image. MiniCPM-V 4.6 trained on up to 128 frames; most cases work well at 4–16. Ignored when no Video input is connected.

properties.name: Vision Projector (mmproj)
properties.description: Path to a companion `mmproj-*.gguf` file. Required for vision input on the Internal (OAIY Local) provider — without it, attached images are rejected with a clear error. Today only Gemma 3 and Qwen 3.5 / 3.6 multimodal mmprojs are wired end-to-end through plugin-llm's vision_chat. External cloud providers ignore this field; they expect images as base64/url via the existing Image Format field.

properties.name: System Prompt
properties.description: Optional system prompt to set context

properties.name: Model
properties.description: Model name (e.g., gpt-5.4-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6)

properties.name: API Endpoint
properties.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

properties.name: API Key
properties.description: API key for authentication

properties.name: Custom Request Body (template)
properties.description: Custom provider only: define the exact JSON request body. Placeholders {{prompt}} {{system}} {{model}} {{apiKey}} are JSON-escaped + quoted; {{messagesJsonRaw}} inserts the raw OpenAI-style messages array; append 'Raw' to any var for unescaped substitution. Leave blank to send the standard OpenAI chat body.

properties.name: Custom Response Path
properties.description: Custom provider only: dot/bracket path into the JSON response to extract the reply text (e.g. 'choices.0.message.content', 'output.text', 'data[0].content'). Leave blank to use the standard OpenAI response path.

properties.name: Custom Request Headers (JSON)
properties.description: Custom provider only: HTTP headers as JSON. {{apiKey}} resolves the API Key Constant. Leave blank for Content-Type: application/json (plus Authorization if a key is set).

properties.name: API Format
properties.description: API format to use

properties.name: Image Format
properties.description: How to handle image input for vision

properties.name: Max Image Dimension
properties.description: Maximum width/height for images (0 = use default 1024px)

properties.name: Max Image Size (KB)
properties.description: Maximum image size in KB (0 = use default 200KB). OpenAI accepts up to 20MB.

properties.name: Max Tokens
properties.description: Maximum tokens in response (0 = no limit)

properties.name: Enable Thinking
properties.description: Enable reasoning/thinking mode for models that support it (e.g. Qwen 3.5)

properties.name: Context Length
properties.description: Max context window size (0 = default)
